title: Sesshin Opening Sesshin
speaker: Hoka Chris Fortin
summary: Hoka Chris Fortin reflects on their upcoming ordination and shares insights from various sources, including the Vimalakirti Sutra, to emphasize the importance of cultivating love, acceptance, and gratitude in the face of uncertainty and complexity. They encourage listeners to stay present and focused on their practice, just as Suzuki Roshi's story about Oka Sotan Roshi highlights the need to let go of distractions and stay mindful. By embracing humility, service, and kindness towards all beings, we can embody the true spirit of Buddha's way and bring benefit to all sentient beings.
